references.text: Great Sidon (Sidon rabba) is mentioned as an important city in the area that the Israelites were to conquer, using the same expression found here.
Sidon and the land of the Sidonians are described as part of the remaining land to be distributed among the tribes.
Rehob is mentioned as a place at the border of the promised land, the same city referred to here in Asher's inheritance.
Rehob and Sidon are listed among the cities where the Asherites did not drive out the Canaanites, showing that these cities were part of the territory allotted to Asher.
The city of Sidon is mentioned in connection with Laish, highlighting Sidon's significance as a major city in the region.
Sidon is noted as a border city of the Canaanite territory, demonstrating its geographical importance in the region.
